The legs are almost entirely hidden by the tall grass. Only the upper shoulder/hip areas are visible. Straightness and muscle definition of the lower limbs cannot be verified.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is visible, raised, and appears to have a thicker base tapering towards the end. It shows a slight upward curve.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dog is stationary (sniffing), not moving. Gait cannot be evaluated in a static image.
